Name: Nehemiah
Summary: Nehemiah was cupbearer to Persia's king who wept over Jerusalem's broken walls, obtained leave to rebuild them, and completed the wall in fifty-two days despite fierce opposition. He led both civic and spiritual renewal.
KeyStory: With a trowel in one hand and a sword in the other, Nehemiah's builders finished the wall because the people had a mind to work and God frustrated their enemies.
LifeLesson: Nehemiah began on his knees weeping over broken walls before he ever lifted a stone. Bring God your broken places — prayer, courage, and steady work rebuild what seemed ruined.
